close_reason: REQUIRETLS advertised in EHLO on TLS sessions only; check+clippy+tests clean
description: Add REQUIRETLS to the EHLO capability response in crates/smtp/src/session.rs. The REQUIRETLS keyword MUST only be advertised when the current connection is already TLS-protected (is_tls flag is true). Currently EHLO is built at lines 285-288 as a format string — extend to conditionally append '250-REQUIRETLS\r\n' when is_tls is true. Per RFC 8689 §2: advertising REQUIRETLS on a plaintext connection is a protocol error.
title: REQUIRETLS EHLO keyword advertisement
